name: Tornavacas (Spain)
description: Square flag gyronny of blue and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Tornavacas (quartered with cows and chequy).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 25 February 1991 (Diario Oficial de Extremadura no. 19 of 7 March 1991); the flag is square, gyronny of blue and white, with the crowned arms of the municipality at its centre.
